```sql
WITH briscoe_county_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Briscoe County' AND border_type = 'county'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM briscoe_county_geom), true) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM briscoe_county_geom))
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1))::numeric, 2) AS avg_elevation
FROM clipped_dem;
```
